units: metres (1 BU = 1 m; Unreal imports x100)
axes: Z up, front faces -Y (street / water side)
pivot: centre of the footprint at ground level; quays and pier: top surface at Z=0
lod_import: each FBX holds an Empty with fbx_type=LodGroup and its children <mesh>_LOD0..LOD3 (Unreal: Import Mesh LODs)

materials.M_Age3_Structure: trim sheet: plaster, ashlar, rusticated quay stone, planks, beam, dressed stone, rubble
materials.M_Age3_Roof: four covering bands: terracotta (0), slate (1), timber shingle (2), lead (3); RoofBand shifts UV V by 0.25 * k
materials.M_Age3_Detail: 4x4 atlas: windows, doors, arcade, lantern glass, iron, rope, canvas, gilt, crate, charred, boarded, broken window

material_parameters.Roof: RoofBand (0-3, V offset 0.25 * k; only on meshes with roof_band_swappable), RoofTint

vertex_colour: Col (corner, sRGB bytes): multiply into base colour (ground grime, wet quay foot below the water line, soot on damaged states)

textures.normal: OpenGL (+Y), flip green on import to Unreal

Base.note: Sail-age default: cream limewash, honey stone, terracotta, lead

CultureA.note: Cliff-Terrace people (warm red canyon): ochre-red plaster, deep red tiles, ochre paint

CultureB.note: Lagoon-Weaver people: silver-grey limewash, moss-grey timber shingle roofs, saffron paint

CultureC.note: Ring-Builder people (cool highland): pale cool limestone, blue-grey slate, blue paint
